what: The 10 reactions (8 of the 97 exported replays) the strict quarantine removes as no_defensible_reaction_support (F-179 floor + D-116 per-row omission), with their evidence, the paper quotes, the L8 evidence-check verdict on head_v2 and the contradiction verdict. why_removed: No reaction row in these payloads carries reaction-level lineage (paper_stated / rag_literature) while the lineage carrier is active elsewhere in the payload, so the F-179 gate refuses the whole pathway and D-116 omits every unsupported reaction. The rows are not removed for anything the paper says.

Both are PRODUCT_CONTRACT section 13 NEGATIVE CONTROLS (mechanistic_relevance=context_only; gold rationale: nothing exportable, an empty pathway plus a rejection reason is correct). 146 = PMC13405594 (steroid).

verdict.deterministic_checks_tell_them_apart: no: 8 of 10 pass every L8 check (the quotes name the participants and are in the paper); the checks cannot see a merged multi-step pathway when the paper names none of its intermediates near the quote
verdict.what_keeping_them_would_ship: glycine -> heme (x3), iron -> heme (x2), acetyl-CoA -> cholesterol (the F-179 class), PSA -> sulfacetamide, NDM-1 meropenem hydrolysis and 2 correct reactions (82 ferrochelatase, 93 ALAS2); 9 of the 10 sit on the two section-13 negative-control papers whose gold rationale says nothing is exportable (all but 146)
verdict.code_change_made: none. The F-179 gate and the D-116 per-row omission are unchanged; where an L8 check fails (62, 93) the flag rides on the row the quarantine report keeps (original_process).
verdict.reason: PRODUCT_CONTRACT section 13 (negative controls) and F-179 (ruled a repeated production defect) outrank a lane brief; keeping them cannot be shown to be no regression (PO hard rule). Needs an orchestrator / PO ruling.
options: (a) Literal D-W24 6: an evidence-checked row (quote in the paper, names a substrate and a product) earns a paper_stated lineage entry and is kept, flagged. Cost: exports the F-179-class rows; 9 of the 10 rows are on negative controls; reverses F-179 / contract section 13.

(b) Keep only rows whose quote names a substrate AND a product and passes every L8 check. On these 10 it would keep the glycine -> heme rows (their quotes name glycine and heme) and not the correct 82 / 93 rows, so it is worse than (c) without an LLM judge.
(c) Status quo (this lane): omitted, listed with evidence and the L8 verdict; revisit with the optional LLM judge (contradiction / merged-step judgement) once a live run is allowed.
